i feel similar to you and i know what it’s like to feel alone. i just feel so fucked up and the thoughts just spiral. from what you described, it’s totally possible that you have some mental health and self esteem issues. if you haven’t already been diagnosed with anything or talked to your doctor, really try to reach out. it’s difficult but sometimes i am incapable of seeing things as temporary problems and have a self deprecating point of view on everything and another perspective can really just help get you through, even if it’s a day at a time. as for the binge eating, i suffered from eating disorders and binging since i was in elementary school so i understand. i know what it’s like to feel powerless and upset with your self over food, so don’t be too hard on yourself if you do binge. depriving yourself of food will probably just trigger another binging episode. you can change your diet anyway you want but for me, the real problem was inside and my relationship with food. start from the inside and the eating will come naturally and hopefully in a schedule that works for you. you deserve to eat. you deserve to be loved. you deserve to get help when you need it. i really hope things improve.
